metadata.calibration: fixed camera, sequential native panels at twelve exact distances; no occlusion

native_build.executable: copied isolated Craftium bin/luanti, selected by GTSession
native_build.implementation: Existing fixed24, integer-region, lighting, material, fog-range and absolute-fog patches reused; no additional C++ or shader edits

metadata.native_execution: CPU software OpenGL; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; not a discrete-GPU hardware test

visual_review.method: Direct inspection of native calibration and scene image montages

visual_limitations: At 34 blocks the native MapBlock bounding volume still submits the marker. At 30,31,32,34 its core equals the actual Fog Color exactly and its texture disappears. This is not exact per-voxel culling at 32.

Native Sky gradients and the constant directional Fog Color leave a faint uniform marker patch. At the horizon the marker is RGB [191,215,254] versus adjacent sky [188,213,254]. Complete equality with every sky pixel is not established.
Native underwater surface polygon/background boundaries remain visible. No Water Shader or underwater post-effect was changed; this run does not claim to remove all underwater visual boundaries.
